core_connection.text: Calm is a subscription service Mia uses. She has written to its support team twice about billing: once about an unwanted annual renewal, and once about being charged for the wrong plan.

evidence.quote: I would like to cancel my Calm Premium subscription
I was charged $69.99 for the annual plan instead

facts.text: Mia's Calm Premium annual plan renewed on June 1, 2025, for $69.99, and she asked for it to be cancelled and refunded.
Mia had not opened the app since August 2024 and said she got no reminder before the renewal.

evidence.quote: I have not opened the app since August 2024

facts.text: Mia wants refunds sent to her original payment method, not as account credits.

evidence.quote: to the original payment method rather than account credits

facts.text: Calm turned off auto-renewal but would not refund the 2025 charge, so Mia asked them to escalate her request.

evidence.quote: Thank you for turning off the auto-renewal.

facts.text: On May 9, 2026, Mia restarted Calm Premium and chose the monthly plan at $14.99, but she was charged $69.99 for the annual plan.

evidence.quote: I selected the monthly plan at $14.99
I was charged $69.99 for the annual plan instead

facts.text: Mia first asked Calm to switch her to the monthly plan and refund the $55.00 difference.
Mia then accepted Calm's offer to cancel the annual plan for a full $69.99 refund, and said she would sign up for the monthly plan again herself.

evidence.quote: Please cancel it and refund the full $69.99
I will sign up for the monthly plan again myself
